Case studies of environmental risk assessment in Vietnam and around the world involving the qualitative and quantitative assessment of risks to human health and the environment resulting from the presence or use of polluting materials are also introduced in this subject. In addition, the subject presents the assessment results of environmental and health risk assessment and provides information for the management of health and environmental risks that contribute to supporting decision-making and the tasks of protecting human health and the environment. [1] Le Thi Hong Tran, Environmental Risk Assessment, 2008, Science and Technology Publishing House

[2] Nguyen Van Phuoc and Nguyen Thi Van Ha, Environmental Quality Management, Chapter 6, Construction Publishing House, 2006.

[3] Le Thi Hong Tran, Health and Ecosystem Risk Assessment, 2008, Science Publishing House.


","en":""},"huongDanCachHoc":{"vi":"

· Students arrange time to participate in class, self-study and study in groups, make and attend a full range of essays, group presentations, and final exams.

· Form of assessment: 10-point scale; less than 5 is not reached; presentation of essays in class

- Essays: 50%

- Exam: 50%

- Participating in actively contributing classroom lectures, performing homework assignments (HW) will be awarded bonus points.

· Eligibility:

- Attend more than 2/3 of the total number of lectures;

- Make and report individual essays and criticisms in groups.


","en":""},"ghiChu":"{"vi":"

This course aims to provide environmental management students with general knowledge of environmental impact assessment (EIA) and environmental risk assessment (RM) as tools for environmental management and protection.
\n\n

This course content provides Environment students with basic knowledge and experience in EIA and WILDLIFE the main steps, methods and tools used in EIA and,RM, two of the environmental management tools. Case studies assessing environmental risks in Vietnam and around the world related to the qualitative and quantitative assessment of risks to human health and the environment due to the presence or use of polluting materials are also introduced in this subject. In addition, the subject presents the assessment results of environmental and health risk assessment and provides information for the management of health and environmental risks that contribute to supporting decision-making and tasks to protect human health and the environment. Students after completing the course are capable of applying knowledge and methodology to forecast the scale of impacts, environmental risks and propose mitigation measures to reduce and avoid the impacts and risks of the specific project.

\n\n\n\n\n\n

-	Các vấn đề liên quan tới môn học

-	Giới thiệu tài liệu tham khảo

Chương 1: Giới thiệu chung
1.1 Những vấn đề chung về ĐTM
1.2 Các bước chính của quá trình ĐTM ở Châu Á
1.3 Nội dung chính của ĐTM
1.4 Vai trò và trách nhiệm của các thành phần chính  tham gia vào quá trình ĐTM
